entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Unio Bernhard Sarlin was a Finnish sport shooter who competed in the 1924 Summer Olympics. He was also a member of the Jäger Movement and an important army officer. In 1924 he finished seventh in the 25 m rapid fire pistol competition.
